description.value: The Old Farm Market is a locally beloved multi-location grocery chain, with the Oak Bay location on Cadboro Bay Road voted #1 Best Local Grocery Store and #1 Best Produce Store. Produce arrives daily from local and BC-grown sources, and the store also runs a full-serve deli offering pastries, pies, fresh salads, and heated samosas. Cyclists will find it a solid resupply point for fresh food, deli items, and made-to-order sandwiches.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 25m; rack at 36m; rack (2 spaces) at 40m; rack (4 spaces) at 44m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms the Oak Bay location at 2585 Cadboro Bay Rd with phone 250-590-9260, matching OSM. The Oak Bay location page explicitly lists farm-fresh produce, a full-serve deli, and made-to-order sandwiches with heated samosas as offerings, confirming hot food and basic groceries. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those are left null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM lists the community as 'Victoria' but the website identifies this as the 'Oak Bay Location'; Oak Bay is a distinct municipality, not the City of Victoria proper.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-regarded local grocery store with fresh produce and hot food; a clear resupply stop for touring cyclists on Cadboro Bay Road in the Victoria area.

Hot food.detail: Website lists 'Sandwiches Made Your Way' with unlimited veggies and free guac, plus 'Get your samosa heated up!' at the Oak Bay location

wow_evidence: voted #1 Best Local Grocery Store and #1 Best Produce Store
